note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Object A is a generic fictional object; no person is drawn and no state is shown as a harm caused by someone. The two states (prior condition / later change) and the levels are supplied placeholders on an illustrative scale, never real figures; nothing is measured, valued, attributed or decided, and no cause, fault, liability or outcome is stated. The tag holds the variation exactly as supplied; the substitution swaps one supplied datum for the alternative value and only then redraws its dependent geometry (the ◆ flag and its edge line, the bracket, the stripes and the mark's edge at the alternative later level). Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events, causalLinks, alternatives and losses are editable, with the inspect fields (focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry, contextLabels); 'object', 'levels' and 'laterLevels' are added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor: 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision)', production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md). True driver: the 1:1 box (the panel with its flags must reach 0.20 of the frame height while the lens keeps ≥ 1.5×, ≥ 0.37 of the short side and a text-dominated window). After trying the fallback layouts (context over the record and band; record and band side by side under the context; record beside the panel inside the context, 'stack2'; context beside the record; the tag over the bracket or beside the panel), the full counts left the 1:1 panel under the floor. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy saved in production/scratch/causation-07/LAW-0708.stress-precap.json): five entries and two accounts → 1:1 17 px, panel 0.195 of the frame height; 16:9 23 px / 0.403; 9:16 20 px / 0.268. Four entries with two accounts: still 0.195. The stress keeps every text at its near-maximum length and caps only the COUNT of accounts put forward at one (baseline 0); after the cap: 1:1 18 px / 0.214 without scaling; 16:9 23 px / 0.403; 9:16 20 px / 0.302. Every text field stays longer than the baseline and every count ≥ the baseline.
